newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A second Egyptian arrested in connection with an alleged plot to bomb a New York railway.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed is a major contributor in a $16 million medical services company to be established in Riyadh.
- Jordanian finance minister estimates his country's foreign debt at $6.7 billion.
- King Fahd says relations between Saudi Arabia and Yemen are strong.
- Foreign investment in Yemen exceeds Arab investment, a Yemeni official says.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines awaits the result of a feasibility study for the setting up of a domestic carrier.
